name: techno
what: Peak-time techno moves: a deep pump on the bass and the music bus from the kick (the rumble ducks), a long low-pass opening on the music bus over each build, a high-pass sweep and reverb throw into the drop, an 8-bar noise riser and an impact, a downlifter out of each drop. Starting points from the techno style's sources; check against the person's references.
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: the same map took the Friends remix's builds 3.7 LU down and the Future House demo's 6.2 (the demo's buildup ended 9 LU under its drop, twice the reference's 4.5). After the first render, read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x}, x about (target minus measured) / 5, then render and repeat.
flanger_note: The drum-bus flanger swell (fx_swell) is out of the default: the person switched it off on the techno remix as too persistent and distracting (2026-10-26). Add it back per song only when asked.
